operations.summary: Read or change one Canvas document with bounded Pencil-style JavaScript; one execution should express one coherent design intent.
operations.guidance:
Execute runs JavaScript against a private JSON clone with no network, files, Account API, browser, timers, or Penkra runtime. Available globals are Get, Insert, Copy, Update, Replace, Delete, Move, and Print. Selectors are exact: `#node-id`, `type:frame`, `name:Header`, `*`, a slash-separated ID path, or an unprefixed exact node ID. Get accepts an optional visitor and `{ limit }`; it returns immutable contexts containing node, parent, index, path, resolved pre-execution bounds, and problems. Its limit defaults to 1,000 and cannot exceed 1,000.

Insert(parent, node, position) adds one node tree; use null for the document root. Update(target, properties) changes properties without replacing ID or children. Copy(target, parent, position, overrides) renews IDs recursively. Replace(target, node), Delete(target), and Move(target, parent, position) each require exactly one target. Print records bounded JSON values in the result. Return values and printed values must be JSON-serializable.

A script may be at most 100,000 UTF-8 bytes and runs for at most five seconds with a 64 MiB heap and 4 MiB stack. Canvas validates the complete resulting tree before changing shared state and commits only when the source sequence is unchanged. The result names touched nodes and reports their current post-execution inspection. Use one execution for one coherent design intent; it may create or update many related nodes. After a write, use a separate read-only execution to inspect affected structure and ancestors, then open the document and use Penkra tab observation when appearance matters. Never blindly replay a CANVAS_DOCUMENT_CHANGED failure.

operations.summary: Open one exact Canvas document in a new or explicitly targeted tab and return its tab ID for visible verification.
operations.guidance: Opening changes visible tab state but does not modify document content. Pass the returned tabId to Penkra's tab snapshot or screenshot operation; Canvas does not expose a separate agent screenshot or export operation.

examples.name: Open a document for visual review

operations.summary: Permanently delete one owned Canvas document after explicit user authorization and exact current-title confirmation; this has no undo.
operations.guidance: Resolve the exact current title with documents.list, obtain explicit authorization for that document, and pass the title unchanged as confirmTitle. Edit or cleanup authorization does not imply document deletion. Deletion works from metadata and can remove an unreadable owned document.

examples.name: Delete an explicitly confirmed test document
